definitions.explanation: A format or approach based on two-way exchange, whether between people or between a person and a system. Widely used in technology (interactive software), education (dialogue-based learning), and communication contexts.

examples.japanese: {対話型|たいわがた}のAIが{普及|ふきゅう}している。
{対話型|たいわがた}の{授業|じゅぎょう}は{学生|がくせい}に{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Dialogue-based classes are popular with students.

examples.japanese: この{美術館|びじゅつかん}では{対話型|たいわがた}の{展示|てんじ}を{取|と}り{入|い}れて{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}の{関心|かんしん}を{引|ひ}いている。
examples.english: This museum uses interactive exhibits to attract visitors' interest.

notes:
{対話|たいわ} means 'dialogue' or 'conversation,' and {型|がた} means 'type' or 'style.' {対話型|たいわがた} describes any system, approach, or format that involves back-and-forth interaction rather than one-way delivery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対話型|たいわがた}AI (interactive AI, conversational AI)
- {対話型|たいわがた}{授業|じゅぎょう} (dialogue-based class)
- {対話型|たいわがた}インターフェース (interactive interface)
- {対話型|たいわがた}{展示|てんじ} (interactive exhibit)
- {対話型|たいわがた}プログラム (interactive program)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インタラクティブ — interactive (loanword; used especially in tech and media contexts)
- {双方向|そうほうこう} — bidirectional, two-way (emphasizes the two-way nature of communication)
- {参加型|さんかがた} — participatory (emphasizes audience involvement rather than dialogue)
